sortieMusters.line: ⚔️ SORTIE — Chris, Luis, Yara take up arms and a day's rations (6,120 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.

log: R1: Chris walks in open-handed, talking — low, steady, unafraid. And impossibly, it listens. It stands down. (Peacemaker: Walk In)
Luis and Yara stood the rear through it, watching the treeline behind them.
